segments.summary: Reviewed promote, reopen, retry, share, revoke, and stop-agent browser wiring. The common dispatcher, projection, accessibility, receipt, and event evidence is strong; share authority and lifecycle, generic retry transitions, and the dual-event stop flow remain under-specified.

Reviewed browser takeover and dock behavior, catalog install/remove/update, and chat file-reference and code-application commands. Layout-only no-persist behavior is explicit, but catalog and code mutations lack authoritative outcome and recovery contracts, and file references lack trust boundaries.

Reviewed archive, restore branching, thread-context close, compact-context, and context-lens subcompact controls. Certification evidence is layered and panel close is explicitly ephemeral, while durable chat changes and reversible context transformations are modeled only as receipts.

Reviewed context-lens mode, toggle, selection and off controls, copy actions, and chat deletion. Copy is appropriately no-persist and accessibility projections are explicit; context-lens transitions and destructive thread deletion lack canonical state semantics.

Reviewed message deletion and editing, effort, export, investigation-bundle export, thread-context focus, and goal start. Focus is reasonably ephemeral, but history mutations, exports, effort semantics, and goal lifecycle creation lack authoritative outcomes and adversarial safeguards.
